cases.description: An early publication-date constraint must survive compression.

messages.content: Research the retrieval literature carefully. The transcript includes early requirements, intermediate discussion, and a recent request that must remain verbatim after compression.
Use only peer-reviewed sources published in or after 2024.
I will enforce the publication date and peer-review requirements while screening every candidate source.
Compare indexing methods, retrieval latency, evaluation design, and limitations with enough detail to support a technical decision.
The comparison plan records methodology, corpus size, hardware assumptions, and uncertainty for each eligible publication.
Which eligible methods remain?
I am preparing the filtered comparison.

required_constraints: Use only peer-reviewed sources published in or after 2024.

cases.description: An evidence-bound finding must retain only frozen identifiers.

messages.content: Evaluate retrieval latency using the benchmark records in this transcript. Preserve structured identifiers and distinguish measured findings from explanatory notes.
Inspect the benchmark and retain its evidence and source identifiers in every confirmed finding.
Method A reduced median retrieval latency by 18 percent.
Check whether the measurement compares the same corpus, hardware, warm-up period, and request distribution.
The audit notes preserve those controls and keep unsupported identifiers outside the confirmed result.
State the verified latency result.
I will answer with the bound source identifier.

required_findings: Method A reduced median retrieval latency by 18 percent.

cases.description: An unresolved hardware question must remain unresolved.

messages.content: Maintain an explicit distinction between confirmed research findings and unresolved deployment assumptions throughout the long conversation.
Do not resolve the deployment GPU question without supporting evidence.
The deployment GPU remains an open question until a hardware record or benchmark provides support.
Continue comparing model quality, memory use, throughput, and operating constraints without inventing the missing GPU.
I will retain the uncertainty and avoid turning an assumption into a confirmed deployment fact.
What remains unresolved?
The hardware question is still open.

unresolved_questions: The deployment GPU remains unresolved pending supporting evidence.

required_constraints: Do not resolve the deployment GPU question without supporting evidence.

cases.description: A matched failed tool call must remain auditable without becoming evidence.

messages.content: Inspect sources but preserve failed tool attempts as failures. A timeout cannot be promoted into evidence or a confirmed finding.
Do not treat the timed-out inspect_source call as evidence.
The research log will retain the failure status and continue without citing the unavailable content.
Try to inspect the unavailable source while retaining the surrounding constraints and previous discussion.
Preparing the source inspection after validating its identifier and preserving the earlier research state.
Inspecting the source.
The source inspection timed out.

required_constraints: Do not treat the timed-out inspect_source call as evidence.

cases.description: A successful tool call, result, and follow-up must remain an intact recent boundary.

messages.content: Keep assistant tool calls paired with their tool results and preserve the complete recent tool turn when creating a compressed model view.
Inspect the selected source and maintain the structured source identifier through the resulting answer.
I will preserve the call-result boundary and keep the final interpretation separate from raw tool output.
The older context also discusses methodology, benchmark scope, caveats, and provenance that may be summarized.
Those older details are eligible for structured summarization before the tool turn begins.
Inspecting source.
Inspection complete.
The source inspection is complete.

cases.description: A second compression round must merge a previous summary with new evidence.

messages.content: Continue a long latency comparison from an existing summary. Preserve the unit constraint and merge only evidence-bound findings into the next summary revision.
Report latency in milliseconds.
Method A median latency is 42 milliseconds.
Add Method B using the same benchmark controls, corpus, warm-up procedure, and measurement units.
Method B median latency is 57 milliseconds.
Retain both measurements and their provenance when the context is compressed for the second time.
Both verified measurements are ready.
Compare their medians.
I will preserve the units and sources.
Give the concise result.

confirmed_findings.claim: Method A median latency is 42 milliseconds.

required_findings: Method A median latency is 42 milliseconds.
Method B median latency is 57 milliseconds.

cases.description: A resumed session must use the persisted revision and append uncovered messages.

messages.content: Resume the saved research session without changing the selected corpus or losing the persisted evidence-bound finding.
Keep the comparison limited to the selected corpus.
The selected corpus contains three benchmark reports.
Persist the result so that a later process can resume the same session and append only uncovered turns.
The prior summary revision records the corpus constraint, verified count, evidence identifier, and source identifier.
Resume the saved comparison.
The persisted context is loaded.

user_constraints: Keep the comparison limited to the selected corpus.

confirmed_findings.claim: The selected corpus contains three benchmark reports.

required_constraints: Keep the comparison limited to the selected corpus.
required_findings: The selected corpus contains three benchmark reports.

cases.description: One optimistic-lock conflict must reload the latest summary and retry once.

messages.content: Retry a summary commit after one optimistic revision conflict while preserving the latest source exclusion and accepted source provenance.
Preserve the user's source-exclusion constraint during the retry.
Source C was excluded at the user's request.
If the revision changes concurrently, reload the newest summary before attempting the atomic commit again.
The retry will use the latest revision and will not restore the excluded source or overwrite concurrent state.
Complete the conflict-aware retry.
The latest summary is ready to commit.

user_constraints: Preserve the user's source-exclusion constraint during the retry.

confirmed_findings.claim: Source C was excluded at the user's request.

required_constraints: Preserve the user's source-exclusion constraint during the retry.
required_findings: Source C was excluded at the user's request.

cases.description: A failed local summary must use the cloud fallback and preserve answer format.

messages.content: Exercise the summary fallback path while retaining the requested answer format, research state, and audit transcript.
Retain the original answer format after summary fallback.
The local summary request failed before producing valid JSON.
Use the configured cloud summary fallback and preserve the structured constraints, findings, and recent messages.
The fallback may continue only after the local failure is recorded with a stable reason for later audit.
Keep the original answer format.
The fallback summary is available.

failed_attempts: Local summary failed before cloud fallback succeeded.

required_constraints: Retain the original answer format after summary fallback.
required_findings: The local summary request failed before producing valid JSON.

cases.description: Dual summary failure near the hard limit must preserve the complete transcript and close with the stable error.

messages.content: Fail closed if both summary clients fail near the hard context limit. Never discard or mutate the original audit transcript.
Do not silently discard original messages after summary failure.
The local summary attempt failed and the complete transcript remains available for fallback or controlled closure.
Attempt the fallback while preserving every earlier message, identifier, boundary, and failure detail exactly.
The fallback summary also failed, so the hard-limit policy must return the stable compression failure code.
Verify that the uncompressed transcript is still byte-for-byte available to the audit path.
Close safely after both failures.
The original transcript is preserved.

required_constraints: Do not silently discard original messages after summary failure.
